sentences.en: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Stevenson's, one of the country's major manufacturers of metal goods.
sentences.zh: 早上好，各位，欢迎来到史蒂文森公司——我国主要的金属制品制造商之一。

sentences.en: Thank you for choosing us for your two weeks of work experience.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们选择我们进行为期两周的工作实习。

sentences.en: My name is Julia Simmons, and since the beginning of this year I've been the managing director.
sentences.zh: 我叫朱莉娅·西蒙斯，自今年年初起担任公司总经理。

sentences.en: Stevenson's is quite an old company.
sentences.zh: 史蒂文森公司是一家历史相当悠久的企业。

sentences.en: Like me, the founder, Ronald Stevenson, went into the steel industry when he left school- that was in 1923.
sentences.zh: 和我一样，公司创始人罗纳德·史蒂文森中学毕业后便进入了钢铁行业——那是在1923年。

sentences.en: He set up this company when he finished his apprenticeship, in 1926. although he actually started making plans two years earlier, in 1924.
sentences.zh: 他于1926年完成学徒期后创办了这家公司，尽管实际上早在两年前即1924年，他就已开始着手规划。

sentences.en: He was a very determined young man!
sentences.zh: 他是一位意志非常坚定的年轻人！

sentences.en: Stevenson's long-term plan was to manufacture components for the machine tools industry- although in fact that never came about — and for the automotive industry, that is, cars and lorries.
sentences.zh: 史蒂文森公司的长期规划是为机床工业（尽管这一目标最终并未实现）以及汽车工业（即轿车和卡车）制造零部件。

sentences.en: However, there was a delay of five years before that happened, because shortly before the company went into production, Stevenson was given the opportunity to make goods for hospitals and other players in the healthcare industry, so that's what we did for the first five years.
sentences.zh: 然而，该规划的实施推迟了五年，因为公司在投入生产前不久，史蒂文森获得了为医院及其他医疗保健行业相关方制造产品的机会，因此我们最初五年主要从事的是这类业务。

sentences.en: Over the years, we've expanded the premises considerably- we were lucky that the site is big enough, so moving to a new location has never been necessary.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我们大幅扩建了厂区——所幸厂址面积足够大，因此从未有必要搬迁至新地点。

sentences.en: However, the layout is far from ideal for modern machinery and production methods, so we intend to carry out major refurbishment of this site over the next five years.
sentences.zh: 不过，现有厂房布局远不能满足现代机械设备与生产工艺的要求，因此我们计划在未来五年内对本厂区进行全面翻新。

sentences.en: I'd better give you some idea of what you'll be doing during your two weeks with us, so you know what to expect.
sentences.zh: 我最好先简要说明一下你们在本公司这两周将要从事的工作，以便你们心中有数。

sentences.en: Most mornings vou'll have a presentation from one of the managers, to learn about their department, starting this morning with research and development.
sentences.zh: 大多数上午，你们将听取一位经理所做的部门介绍，以了解其所在部门的情况；今天上午的首场介绍将围绕研发部门展开。

sentences.en: And you'll all spend some time in each department, observing what's going on and talking to people- as long as you don't stop them from doing their work altogether!
sentences.zh: 你们还将分别到各个部门实地观察工作流程，并与员工交流——当然前提是不要完全妨碍他们正常开展工作！

sentences.en: In the past, a teacher from your school has come in at the end of each week to find out how the group were getting on, but your school isn't able to arrange that this year.
sentences.zh: 过去，贵校的一位老师会在每周结束时前来了解小组实习进展，但今年贵校无法安排此项安排。

sentences.en: OK, now HI briefly help you to orientate yourselves around the site.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在我来简要帮你们熟悉一下厂区布局。

sentences.en: As you can see, we're in the reception area, which we try to make attractive and welcoming to visitors.
sentences.zh: 如您所见，我们现在位于接待区，我们努力将其布置得美观且富有亲和力，以迎接来访者。

sentences.en: There's a Audioscripts corridor running left from here, and if you go along that, the door facing you at the end is the entrance to the coffee room.
sentences.zh: 从这里向左延伸着一条走廊，沿此走廊前行，尽头正对着你们的那扇门便是咖啡室的入口。

sentences.en: This looks out onto the main road on one side, and some trees on the other, and that'll be where you meet each morning.
sentences.zh: 咖啡室一侧面向主干道，另一侧则面对几棵树，你们每天早晨都将在此集合。

sentences.en: The factory is the very big room on the far side of the site.
sentences.zh: 工厂是厂区最远端那个非常大的房间。

sentences.en: Next to it is the warehouse, which can be accessed by lorries going up the road to the turning area at the end.
sentences.zh: 工厂旁边是仓库，货车可沿道路驶入尽头的回车区，从而进入仓库。

sentences.en: You can get to the warehouse bv crossing to the far side of the courtyard, and then the door is on vour right.
sentences.zh: 你们可穿过庭院到达最远一侧，然后右手边即为仓库入口。

sentences.en: Somewhere you'll be keen to find is the staff canteen.
sentences.zh: 你们一定很想去找到的地方是员工餐厅。

sentences.en: This is right next to reception.
sentences.zh: 它就紧邻接待区。

sentences.en: I can confidently say that the food's very good, but the view isn't.
sentences.zh: 我可以自信地说，这里的饭菜非常可口，但景观却并不理想。

sentences.en: The windows on one side look onto a corridor and courtyard, which aren't very attractive at all, and on the other onto the access road, which isn't much better.
sentences.zh: 一侧窗户朝向一条走廊和庭院，而那里毫无吸引力；另一侧则朝向进出通道，情况也好不到哪儿去。

sentences.en: You'll be using the meeting room quite often, and vou'll find it bv walking along the corridor to the left of the courtyard, and continuing along it to the end.
sentences.zh: 你们会经常使用会议室，它位于庭院左侧的走廊尽头。

sentences.en: The meeting room is the last one on the right, and I'm afraid there's no natural davliaht in the room.
sentences.zh: 会议室是走廊右侧的最后一间房，很抱歉，室内没有自然采光。

sentences.en: Then you'll need to know where some of the offices are.
sentences.zh: 接下来，你们还需了解一些办公室的位置。

sentences.en: The human resources department is at the front of this building, so you head to the left along the corridor from reception, and it's the second room you come to.
sentences.zh: 人力资源部位于本栋建筑的前部：从接待区沿走廊向左走，第二间房便是。

sentences.en: It looks out onto the main road.
sentences.zh: 该办公室面向主干道。

sentences.en: And finally, the boardroom, where you'll be meeting sometimes.
sentences.zh: 最后是董事会会议室，你们有时将在那里开会。

sentences.en: That has quite a pleasant view, as it looks out on to the trees.
sentences.zh: 那里的景观相当宜人，因为它正对着一片树林。

sentences.en: Go along the corridor past the courtyard, right to the end.
sentences.zh: 请沿走廊穿过庭院一直走到尽头。

sentences.en: The boardroom is on the left, next to the factory.
sentences.zh: 董事会会议室位于左手边，紧邻工厂。

sentences.en: OK, now are there any questions before we ...
sentences.zh: 好的，那么在我们……之前，大家还有什么问题吗？
